title: Russian night attacks kill 1 in Kyiv, leave 350,000 in Dnipro without power
summary: In Kyiv, multiple Russian ballistic missiles struck just after 10 p.m. local time. According to Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, warehouse buildings in the city's Darnitsky district were struck, starting fires.

title: Seven Russian tankers shipping diesel to US identified, located
summary: A live tracker map developed by Greenpeace, an international environmental organization, shows Russian tankers currently moving across the Atlantic Ocean, with one vessel approaching the U.S. East Coast.

title: Drone attack reportedly kills worker at Russian-occupied Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant
summary: The plant has repeatedly faced threats to nuclear safety, including drone attacks, disruptions to external power supplies, and incidents affecting plant workers.
